controls.name: Administrative Safeguards

controls.name: AI Awareness

controls.name: AI Data Preparation

controls.name: AI Data Provenance
controls.description: Record and maintain the provenance of data used in AI systems (source, transformations, lineage, handling history) to support reproducibility, accountability and impact assessment.

controls.name: AI Data Resources

controls.name: AI Human Resources

controls.name: AI Incident Communication

controls.name: AI Management Review
controls.description: Top management reviews the AIMS at planned intervals, considering the required inputs (status of actions, changes, performance, risks, opportunities, improvement), and produces outputs on decisions and improvements.

controls.name: AI Management System Establishment
